name: PMO Project Closure
html:
Project Closure — {{ doc.project }}

Closure date: {{ doc.closure_date }} · Issued by: {{ doc.issued_by }} · {{ doc.issued_at }}

Final result: {{ doc.final_result or "" }}

Accepted by: {{ doc.accepted_by or "—" }}{% if doc.accepted_on %} ({{ doc.accepted_on }}){% endif %}

{%- set s = json.loads(doc.snapshot or "{}") -%} {%- set sch = s.get("schedule", {}) -%} {%- set eff = s.get("effort", {}) -%}

Schedule (as of closure date)

  • Baseline end: {{ sch.get("baseline_end") or "—" }}
  • Committed end: {{ sch.get("committed_end") or "—" }}
  • Forecast / final end: {{ sch.get("forecast_end") or "—" }}
  • Slip vs baseline (d): {{ sch.get("slip_vs_baseline_days") if sch.get("slip_vs_baseline_days") is not none else "—" }}
  • Slip vs commitment (d): {{ sch.get("slip_vs_committed_days") if sch.get("slip_vs_committed_days") is not none else "—" }}
  • Overdue at cutoff: {{ sch.get("overdue_at_cutoff") if sch.get("overdue_at_cutoff") is not none else "—" }}

Effort (as of closure date)

  • Planned hours: {{ eff.get("planned_hours") if eff.get("planned_hours") is not none else "—" }}
  • Actual hours: {{ eff.get("actual_hours") if eff.get("actual_hours") is not none else "—" }}
  • % complete: {{ eff.get("percent_complete") if eff.get("percent_complete") is not none else "—" }}

Changes

Total change requests: {{ s.get("changes", {}).get("total", 0) }}

Pending items transferred: {{ doc.pending_items_transferred or "—" }}

Observations: {{ doc.closure_observations or "—" }}

{%- if doc.economics_snapshot and can_see_project_economics(doc.project) -%} {%- set e = json.loads(doc.economics_snapshot) -%}

Economic evidence (restricted; {{ e.get("as_of") }})

  • Authorized revenue: {{ e.get("authorized_revenue") if e.get("authorized_revenue") is not none else "—" }} {{ e.get("currency") or "" }}
  • Authorized cost: {{ e.get("authorized_cost") if e.get("authorized_cost") is not none else "—" }}
  • Authorized margin: {{ e.get("authorized_margin") if e.get("authorized_margin") is not none else "—" }}
  • Billed: {{ e.get("total_billed_amount") }}
  • Comparable registered cost: {{ e.get("comparable_cost") }}
  • Gross margin (native): {{ e.get("gross_margin") }}
{%- endif -%}
Frozen evidence · snapshot hash {{ doc.snapshot_hash }}. Rebuilt only from the frozen closure snapshot, never from live data.
